faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the TMC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application for the TMC Recruitment 2026 is September 7, 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well in advance of the deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Quality Manager and Linen & Laundry Supervisor posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies announced by the Tata Memorial Centre (TMC) for the posts of Quality Manager and Linen & Laundry Supervisor.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Quality Manager post?
faq.answer: For the Quality Manager position, candidates must possess an M. Sc. or equivalent post-graduate degree with at least 50% marks, or a Master's Degree in Hospital/Healthcare/Administration Management with 3 years of relevant experience.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the advertised posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all the advertised posts is 35 years. Age relaxation will be provided as per the government's regulations.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Linen & Laundry Supervisor role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Linen & Laundry Supervisor post will receive a monthly salary ranging from Rs. 25,506/-.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for the TMC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the TMC Recruitment 2026.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for these TMC vacancies?
faq.answer: The selection process for the TMC Recruitment 2026 will involve a Walk-in Interview followed by Document Verification.

faq.question: Q8. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for the TMC Recruitment 2026 is offline. Candidates need to download the application form and submit it via post or as instructed in the notification.

faq.question: Q9. Where will the walk-in interview be conducted?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be conducted at Muzaffarpur, Bihar, with the pincode 842004. The exact venue details will be available in the official notification.

faq.question: Q10. What is the job type for these positions?
faq.answer: The positions of Quality Manager and Linen & Laundry Supervisor are contractual roles under the Tata Memorial Centre (TMC).
